WITH spatial_with_projects AS (
  SELECT 
    ss.arcref,
    ss.boxx,
    ss.boxz,
    p.fundflux,
    CASE 
      WHEN ss.boxx IS NOT NULL AND ss.boxz IS NOT NULL AND ss.boxz != 0
      THEN ss.boxx / ss.boxz 
      ELSE NULL 
    END AS ratio
  FROM scanspatial ss
  INNER JOIN projects p ON ss.arcref = p.arcregistry
),
project_ratios AS (
  SELECT 
    arcref,
    fundflux,
    AVG(ratio) AS project_ratio
  FROM spatial_with_projects
  WHERE ratio IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY arcref, fundflux
),
funding_source_averages AS (
  SELECT 
    fundflux,
    AVG(project_ratio) AS funding_avg
  FROM project_ratios
  GROUP BY fundflux
),
excess_calculated AS (
  SELECT 
    pr.arcref,
    pr.fundflux,
    pr.project_ratio,
    pr.project_ratio - fsa.funding_avg AS excess
  FROM project_ratios pr
  INNER JOIN funding_source_averages fsa ON pr.fundflux = fsa.fundflux
)
SELECT 
  arcref,
  fundflux,
  project_ratio,
  excess
FROM excess_calculated
ORDER BY excess IS NULL, excess DESC
LIMIT 10;
